git.working_tree_clean_at_baseline_evidence: git status --porcelain returned empty before any verification command ran
git.tree_churn_note: eval/run_evaluation.py and scripts/smoke_test.py rewrite their own tracked evidence JSONs on every run, so the tree is no longer clean after the verification sweep. Mechanical diff of the changed JSON keys yields exactly ['generated', 'latency_ms', 'latency_ms_p50', 'latency_ms_p95'] — wall-clock timestamps and per-query timing. No retrieval result, count, pass flag, or assertion outcome changed. This is expected script behaviour, not drift.

store_note: evaluation_case measured twice by independent surfaces: a full metadata scan and a Chroma where-filter. Both zero.

tests.count_provenance: pytest's summary line is swallowed in this environment. 219 is the sum of pytest --collect-only -q per-file counts; 'failed 0' is established by exit code 0 on the full run.
